messages:
jamie: Quick sync — planning the Tue release window at 10:30 UTC. We need clear owners for FE canary, API patch, and infra migration. Reply with 'slot take' + one-line smoke/rollback checklist. I'll coordinate deploy board updates.

katie: slot take — frontend canary (web-frontend). PR #4521 is green on CI and e2e. Est timeline: canary ramp 5m (5% -> 25%) + 3m observation. Smoke checklist: hit /health, run ui-smoke.sh, verify session persistence. Rollback plan: repromote previous image tag `v1.9.3` and revert ingress rule. I'll own 10:15-10:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

riley: slot take — infra migration. Adding `feature_flags.enabled` column; migration ~12m on prod shard. Will run db-maint mode and run migration during lower traffic. Rollback: schema add is non-destructive, fallback via service toggle + backfill if needed. Request: can we start infra at 10:10 so migration finishes before FE ramp? Need 2 extra write replicas for the window.

miguel: slot take — backend API patch (svc-api). PR 4973 ready, non-breaking schema, hot deployable. Est 2-3 minutes to roll; I'll warm up caches pre-deploy. I'll push at ~10:28 so API and FE canary overlap cleanly.

zach: SRE oncall 10:00-11:00. I'll own the smoke run and dashboards. Posting quick smoke checklist snippet to run during the canary:

```
# smoke checklist (short)
curl -fsS https://frontend.example/health || exit 1
curl -fsS https://api.example/health || exit 1
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=web-frontend -o wide
# verify p95 latency on APM < 250ms, errors < 1%
```

I'll set alerts for: CPU > 90% sustained 2m, p95 latency +40% baseline, error rate >1%. If any trigger, hit rollback. I'll also monitor the canary logs tail: `kubectl logs -f deploy/web-frontend-canary`.

devops-bot: deploy-slot reserved: @katie, @riley, @miguel for thread 1739001234 — reservation expires in 24h.

jamie: Thanks — @riley can you confirm 10:10 start for infra? @katie keep previous image pinned until canary passes 10m. @zach can you paste the exact alert channels you'll use so we can A/B test notifications?

katie: Confirmed, will keep `v1.9.3` pinned and will push canary traffic increments manually. I'll post quick status updates in this thread during the window.

riley: Confirmed 10:10. I'll do a dry-run migration 30m prior and will call out if we need to shift the timeline. If migration takes >12m I'll call a pause and revert reads.

miguel: I'll be ready to push at 10:28. Will send a short preflight message at 10:20 with warmup cache counts.

zach: Alerts will go to #sre-alerts and pager duty 'infra-oncall'. I'll also post a short status card to #eng-releases at +1m and +10m after canary start. Thresholds: CPU 90% 2m, errors >1% 5m, p95 +40% over baseline.

jamie: Perfect — I'll update the release ticket with owners and timeline, and pin this thread to the deploy board. Thanks all, :rocket:
